judgements.justification: B's AC held the paper to a poster, required citing Knight and van Vreeswijk-Sompolinsky, and suggested retitling away from 'arbitrarily fast computation', while A's one-sentence meta-review took the claim at face value and gave an oral.
No committee settled on flat marginal-accept ratings: A rated 8, 7, 8, 9 and B rated 9, 8, 3.
